[See Fiscal Impact]

summary: This memorandum of understanding (MOU) sets up intern and fieldwork placements in district schools for Saint Mary's College students seeking teaching, special education and pupil personnel services credentials, and related degrees. The term is July 1, 2024 to June 30, 2029.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
